description: Sends the SMS through kwtSMS in test mode (test=1): it is not delivered to any phone. Its credits are held until the message is deleted from the Sending Queue in the kwtSMS account. Hourly and daily limits apply.

client_ref.description: Optional id for this send; a repeated id returns the first result and sends nothing

mobiles.description: Phone numbers in international format, for example 965XXXXXXXX

name: send_test_sms
title: Send test SMS
